reconstructionNotes: All product images are AI reconstructions of the referenced editorial, not verified retail products.
Material terms describe visual appearance only; composition, brand, price and purchase URL are unknown.
Partly occluded backs, sleeves, waistbands, closures, opposite shoes and hidden jewellery surfaces are conservatively reconstructed.
Exact actual and feels-like temperatures are undocumented and remain null.
Existing app item IDs are retained via appItemId. Composite legacy accessory IDs retain the scarf; the pouch has a new ID.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, shopping paper bags and keys are scene props.
